scores.evidence: Phase 1 — Tenancy, identity, and ledger core ... Exit check: V1 and V2 pass. Phase 2 "Depends on: Phase 1; V1, V2."
scores.rationale: Phases go from isolation and ledger substrate up to invoicing, metering, payments and live exposure, each gated on validated dependencies and a dependency map.

scores.evidence: POST /v1/usage-events ... → GET /v1/invoices/draft returns a draft invoice containing one rated line and a $0 total.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real production end-to-end slice across all tiers, with deploy, rollback, alerting and a V0 exit check.

scores.evidence: Tenancy and isolation | R3 ... Default: Shared Postgres, tenant_id on every row, RLS ... Flip condition: V1 fails, or a contract requires a dedicated DB
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions have reversibility class, default, assumption, validation and flip condition, and unknowns are labelled.

scores.evidence: Phase 1 — Tenancy, identity, and ledger core (widest blast radius first); Phase 5 — Single-tenant live-money canary (smallest exposure first)
scores.rationale: Widest-impact isolation and ledger work precedes leaf features, and exposure widens from one tenant to cohorts.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: Allow-listed access, secrets in a manager, least-privilege IAM, WAF ... Phase 3: Per-tenant quotas, rate limits, payload validation
scores.rationale: The security column has concrete items for every phase from 0 to 6, with V1 and V4 as gates.

scores.evidence: Structured logs and one trace per request with tenant_id and opaque IDs only... Dashboards for RED metrics and outbox lag. One synthetic probe runs every minute.
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in each later phase.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: IaC, immutable images, pinned dependencies; Phase 3: Replayable event log, load-test harness in repo
scores.rationale: Reproducibility measures (IaC, fixtures, golden files, replay, test-mode fixtures) appear in every phase.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Expand/contract migrations, PITR enabled; Phase 3: Backpressure, dead-letter queue, replay; Phase 5: Instant charge kill-switch
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears concretely in every phase, including rollback and idempotency, and is not left to the end.

scores.evidence: ## 8. AI layer N/A — no AI component.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Multi-currency and FX: pulled forward when the first tenant needs a second currency (the ledger stores currency from day one).
scores.rationale: Eight deferred items each have an explicit pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content; the only soft spot is that several budget inputs are marked UNKNOWN, but they are labelled honestly and have owners.
